caption: The drawing depicts a tall grandfather clock standing upright against a plain, off-white background. The clock case is composed of a dark reddish-brown wood with visible grain, featuring ornate molding and detailing at the top. The upper part of the clock includes a domed, arched bonnet with three finials and carved decorative swirls. Below the bonnet, there is a brass or gold colored clock face with a silver circular dial and black Roman numerals, two dark hands, and a second smaller dial above the main face. The clock face is set within a rectangular frame bordered with golden swirling patterns. The case has a central door with a brass keyhole and hinge, set within a beveled panel, and the lower portion is broader and set on short bracket feet. The clock is rendered in fine detail, highlighting wood patterns and metallic elements, with the name "Gilbert Sackerman" written in the bottom left corner of the image. There are faint pencil notations in the top right corner and some marks on the background.
title: Clock
